# SIH 2026 Problem Statements Archive

> Community-maintained archive of all Smart India Hackathon 2026 problem statements.
> Source: https://sih.gov.in/sih2026PS | License: CC-BY-4.0 | Code: MIT

## About

This site archives all 229 problem statements from Smart India Hackathon 2026,
published by the Innovation Cell, Government of India. Each problem statement
includes title, description, organization, theme, category, deadline, and dataset links.

## Quick Links

- All problem statements: https://sih2026.vuce.in/
- Full dataset (JSON): https://sih2026.vuce.in/api/ps.json
- Themes index: https://sih2026.vuce.in/themes
- Organizations index: https://sih2026.vuce.in/orgs
- GitHub repo: https://github.com/vedantchalke36/sih-2026-problem-statements

## Data Access

### For AI Agents and Researchers

- **JSON API**: GET https://sih2026.vuce.in/api/ps.json — Full dataset with all fields
- **Themes API**: GET https://sih2026.vuce.in/api/themes.json — Theme list with counts
- **Organizations API**: GET https://sih2026.vuce.in/api/orgs.json — Organization list with counts
- **Individual PS**: GET https://sih2026.vuce.in/api/ps/SIH26001.json — Single problem statement

All API responses are cached for 24 hours and include CORS headers.

### Data Fields

Each problem statement contains:
- `sno` — Serial number
- `ps_number` — Unique PS identifier (e.g., SIH26001)
- `title` — Problem statement title
- `org` — Submitting organization
- `department` — Department within the organization
- `category` — "Software" or "Hardware"
- `theme` — Problem theme (e.g., "Disaster Management", "Agriculture")
- `deadline` — Idea submission deadline
- `deadline_date` — ISO date format
- `ideas` — Submitted ideas count
- `dataset_link` — Associated dataset URL (if any)
- `contact` — Contact information
- `youtube` — YouTube link (if any)
- `description` — Full problem description
- `scraped_at` — Last scrape date

## Dataset Statistics

- **Total statements**: 229
- **Software**: 175
- **Hardware**: 54
- **Themes**: 17
- **Organizations**: 30
- **Last updated**: Daily at 04:00 IST via automated scraper

## Browsable Pages

- `/` — Homepage with search, filters, and statistics
- `/ps/SIH26001` — Individual problem statement detail page
- `/themes` — Browse all themes
- `/themes/disaster-management` — Statements in a specific theme
- `/orgs` — Browse all organizations
- `/orgs/drdo` — Statements from a specific organization
- `/shortlist` — Saved statements (browser-local)

## Technical Notes

- This is a fully static site (SSG). All pages are pre-rendered at build time.
- Data is refreshed daily via GitHub Actions from sih.gov.in.
- Search uses client-side fuzzy matching (Fuse.js).
- Shortlists are stored in browser localStorage (no server).
- The site is deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
